evidence.observation: Reboiler heater temperature climbs steadily from 408.6 to 416.9 °C, far above all other temperatures (~65-76 °C), suggesting heater running dry/overheating or sensor fault
Reboiler vessel temperature only creeps 65.9 -> 66.6 °C despite large heater power indication
Upper column temperatures drift downward (~66.5 -> 64.6), column cooling rather than establishing a separation profile
Distillate and reflux flows are low and erratic (0.16-0.56), no stable reflux established
Column pressure drop near zero (~0.3-0.6 mbar), indicating negligible vapor traffic

args.missing_evidence: Heater power/setpoint for H701 and an independent reboiler temperature reading to distinguish T701 sensor drift from genuine heater overheating; also a distillate composition sample.
